_note: Sickness (docs/specs/barge/06-sickness.md; code campaign/sickness.gd). Every number here is a starting default [ours]: after the 5-year startup sim the cases and deaths per town per year go to Douglas; nothing is tuned toward an outcome. Days are campaign days (a season is 30 days, a year 120). Rates are per person per day.
_disease_note: One row per disease (adding one = one row). where: town (conditions in the household and town), contact (only from a sick person: never starts by itself), camp (forces in the field and the company out of town), wound (an open untreated wound of a company man). inc / sick: incubation and sick days (min, max, whole days). shed: share of the incubation at its end during which he already passes it on (carriers travel while incubating). bed: share of cases bed-ridden (no work, no wage). death: chance per sick day by age band (child / adult / elder, race ages). immune: 0 none, -1 for life, N = years after recovery. base: cases per person-day at reference conditions (town rows) or per man-day in the field (camp) or per open wound-day (wound). season: spring, summer, autumn, winter weights. climate: cold / temperate / hot weights. water: [river or coast town, dry town] weights. crowd / poor / hunger / cold: added to the condition factor K = 1 + crowd x crowding above the home's room (0..1.5) + poor x (homeless or poorhouse) + hunger x (family hungry) + cold x (no firewood at home, or homeless; +0.5 when the town is short of clothing). home / town / work / camp: contact rates per day: per sick member of his household, x the town's share of people sick, per sick workmate (business staff, the garrison, a caravan crew), x the share of a force sick (household rates set for a household attack rate of about 10% flux, 15% winter cough, 50% pox over the shedding days; town rates for about 0.03 / 0.1 / 1.4 town cases per case). catch: catch multiplier by age band. race: catch multiplier by race (race_all applies to every row). relapse: [chance, min days, max days]: after recovery the disease comes back in a new bout; immunity only after the last bout.

marsh_fever.name: marsh fever
marsh_fever.spread: hot, wet seasons by rivers and coasts

camp_sickness.name: camp sickness
camp_sickness.spread: armies and crowded camps in the field, poor food

_body_note: Body condition meter (spec 6b), 1 = well fed, 0 = dead of hunger. fall: per full day without food (about 45 days to death); weak: x for children, elders, the sick and nursing mothers (a child under 1 year at the breast); refill: per fed day. catch / death: low condition raises every disease's catch and death chance by x (1 + w x (1 - condition)). eat_order by culture row (default: workers, then children, then elders).
_unit_note: A sick man fielded in battle (spec 5): END and STR multipliers, fatigue gain multiplier, focus change (inside the food and drink focus cap).
_remedy_note: A remedy (herbalist's good) given to a sick person: his remaining sick days x days, his death chance per sick day x death. A family buys one only with reserve_days of food money left over after it.
_carrier_note: stay: days a carrier spends in a town he passes (caravan crews at the far market, the company per day in town, a force camped within near_px of a town). edge: chance per day that a traveller from beyond the map edge brings the disease into the town nearest the edge (contact-only rows; a rare world event, logged).
_herbalist_note: Herbalists per town: 1 business row of cap 1 + size / 2 (economy.json row herbalist, good remedy).
